name: Takishima Misa
source:
An honor student with good conduct.

She's the protagonist's beloved daughter, who chose to live with her father when her parents divorced. Currently a high school student.

To support her father who's bad at anything that isn't work, she has been cooking for him since she was young, and is extremely kind. 

She loves shopping, and does act her age. Nowadays, she apparently attends a cram school everyday to prepare for the entrance exams, but...

[From [url=https://web.archive.org/web/20240721023848/http://chiroame.sakura.ne.jp/game/006/kyara.html] archived official site[/url]]
